name: OmniQoL
description: All-in-one modular Quality of Life suite for Pokémon Red, Blue, and Yellow. Features Running Shoes (with Pikachu follower sync), modern Gen 6+ EXP Share, Trade Evolutions at Lv. 40, Catch All 151 Pokémon, Move Relearner in all Pokémon Centers (with pre-evolution move retention), and freely replaceable HM moves, all with native Options Menu integration.
